propellerDiameter.source: 11 ft 6 in × 0.3048; Wikipedia DC-3A-S1C3G / AOPA 11 ft 7 in

nasmMoveContractorFuselageWidth.note: NASM 3-D record 414 cm 'width of the main fuselage' from a move contractor. Rejected as fuselage diameter: it is far above the civil cabin type. Treated as a handling/cradle measurement, not a body station.

heightAttitudes.note: AOPA 16 ft 11.5 in tail-down vs 23 ft 6 in tail-up. This prototype sits three-point (tail-down). Level-attitude engineering height is not this number.

fuselageMaxWidth.note: ≈9 ft exterior from 7 ft 8 in cabin plus skin/frames

outerDihedralDeg.note: outer-panel type figure, not a measured drawing

cowlInnerRadius.note: open NACA cowl around the radial

sparFrontChord.note: front spar at 18% local chord; type three-spar box, not a measured drawing

sparRearChord.note: rear spar at 70% local chord; flap and aileron hinge

finHingeChord.note: rudder hinge at 60% local fin chord

stabHingeChord.note: elevator hinge at 72% local stabilizer chord

flapDownDegrees.note: TE down about +X; landing-ish, not a measured travel
